question: The natural aging of a lake by nutrient enrichment of its water is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**eutrophication**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When a body of water becomes **highly mineralized and nutrient-rich, **planktonic algae develop rapidly as a result of this.
 
• **Eutrophication** is the process of excessive growth of planktonic algae in nutrient-rich water.
 
• Hypoxia is formed as a result of excessive planktonic algae development, which leads to the death of aquatic animals due to low oxygen levels and the gradual disappearance of the lake.
 
• **Excess phosphorus** is usually always the source of eutrophication in freshwater ecosystems, but nitrogen and phosphorus may play diverse roles in marine habitats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Plankton** is a varied group of organisms that live in water and are unable to swim against the stream. 
 
• **Biomagnification** is the accumulation of a chemical by an organism as a result of water and food exposure, resulting in a concentration that is higher than would have been expected from equilibrium if the chemical had only been exposed to water.
